AC1.note: Verified: PR #266 (feat(agent): add safe web fetch tool, merged 2026-08-11, commit d0fbc350) adds web-fetch-tool.ts registering web_fetch with a required url param; agent.ts trusted system instruction describes it as retrieval of a known public URL.

AC2.note: Verified: PR #266 web-fetch-tool.ts rejects non-HTTPS/credentialed URLs (rejects with explicit error) and returns bounded text on success, per web-fetch-tool.test.ts.

AC3.note: Verified: PR #266 body states the tool rejects credentials, local/private/metadata addresses, non-text content, and oversized responses; web-fetch-tool.test.ts covers 'rejects non-HTTPS, credentials, private DNS and binary content'.

AC4.note: Verified: PR #266 uses manual redirect handling with each redirect destination re-resolved/validated before request, per PR security note and web-fetch-tool.test.ts 'validates each redirect with the same public-DNS policy'.

AC5.note: Verified: PR #266 sandboxed-web-transport enforces no caller headers/cookies/credentials and returns tool errors rather than throwing, confirmed by web-fetch-tool.ts's isError result shape.

AC6.note: Verified: PR #266 strips scripts/styles, caps content, and agent.ts labels web_fetch output as untrusted external content never to be treated as instructions.

AC7.note: Verified: PR #266 test plan reports 5 focused web-fetch tests passing plus 49 in the focused agent/read-only suite; web-fetch-tool.test.ts covers AC1-AC6.
